Description
 Our client is a global leader in music rights management, serving as an advocate for the value of music. It collects blanket license fees from businesses that use music, entitling those businesses to play or sync any songs from the client’s repertoire of over 22.4 million musical works. On a regular basis, the client distributes the money to songwriters, composers, and music publishers as royalties to those members whose works have been performed.
 Requirements
 Education
Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Computer Science, Mathematics, or equivalent industry experience.
 Experience & Technical Focus
Core Full Stack Expertise: Strong hands-on experience developing end-to-end web applications utilizing modern multi-tier design patterns and frameworks (e.g., MVC, Entity Framework).
 C# & Backend Development:
5 years of Object-Oriented development experience.
5 years of C# project implementation experience (additional experience is strongly preferred).
Strong hands-on expertise in developing C# server-side, multi-threaded services and deep knowledge of the .NET framework utilizing Visual Studio.
 UI & Frontend Development:
Strong professional experience with React (core requirement for this role).
Preferred experience with MUI (Material UI) or similar UI component frameworks.
Proficiency in HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, Typescript.
 Database Experience:
Strong relational database experience with a focus on PostgreSQL (MS SQL experience is also highly valued).
 Repositories, Protocols & Platforms:
Proven experience with Git repositories (knowledge of industry-standard source control systems; Team Foundation Server/VSTS/Azure DevOps is a plus).
Deep understanding of industry-standard communication protocols including REST, JSON, XML.
Experience working with AWS cloud environments is preferred.
Strong experience working within Agile software development methodologies. 
 Skills And Abilities
Autonomy & Pace: Must possess the ability to work independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
Collaboration: Must be a self-motivated team player who understands the importance of teamwork, collaboration, and open communication, including a willingness to occasionally work in a pair-programming environment.
Artifact Creation: Must possess the ability to create and maintain technical artifacts including use cases, data flow charts, process flow diagrams, software requirements documents, and functional specifications documents.
Problem Solving: Must possess strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical documentation skills.
Communication: Must possess the ability to effectively present technical information and respond to questions from both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Best Practices: Must have an excellent understanding and hands-on experience with design and development best practices, detail orientation, and strong attention to detail.
Enterprise Mindset: Experience with distributed systems or a large enterprise background is preferred.
Testing & Automation: Understanding of SDLC automation concepts such as continuous integration (CI/CD) and the ability to implement strong unit and service-level tests.
 Job responsibilities
Application Lifecycle Management: Participate in all phases of managing the Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) for the Soundmouse platform: requirements analysis, full-stack development, testing, and implementation.
Technical Design & Logic: Participate actively in technical logic and design discussions, ensuring frontend UI components seamlessly integrate with backend services.
Architecture Alignment: Identify the appropriate software architecture for full-stack features based on product requirements and BMI enterprise architecture guidelines.
Database Management: Design, maintain, and optimize PostgreSQL database schemas, queries, and stored procedures to support high-performing application features.
UI/UX Integration: Work closely with UX/UI designers to translate wireframes and visual designs into responsive, consistent, and intuitive React-based user experiences.
Review Process: Lead the review process for software architecture documents and contribute to the review and analysis of business requirements.
Documentation: Create, maintain, and present clear technical documentation (including project plans, software program guides, and user documentation) to different audiences and technical levels.
Assessments & Logistics: Perform resource, technical, and risk assessments for upcoming Soundmouse application features.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with other development, architecture, and product development teams across the broader BMI organization to ensure unified product delivery.
Vendor Management: Work with 3rd party vendors on technical design/specifications, development, testing, and deployment to ensure external deliverables meet Soundmouse standards.
Project Delivery: Assist in the timely completion of assigned development projects and contribute to the estimation of personnel requirements, cost, and time.
Corporate Citizenship: Support BMI Core Values, cultivate a culture of diversity and inclusion, and maintain regular attendance.
Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and architectural discussions within an Agile framework.
Other duties as assigned.
 What we offer
 Empowering Projects: With 500+ clients spanning diverse industries and domains, we provide an exciting opportunity to contribute to groundbreaking projects that leverage cutting-edge technologies. As a team, we engineer digital products that positively impact people’s lives.
 Empowering Growth: We foster a culture of continuous learning and professional development. Our dedication is to provide timely and comprehensive assistance for every consultant through our dedicated Learning & Development team, ensuring their continuous growth and success.
 DE&I Matters: At GlobalLogic, we deeply value and embrace diversity . We are dedicated to providing equal opportunities for all individuals, fostering an inclusive and empowering work environment.
 Career Development: Our corporate culture places a strong emphasis on career development, offering abundant opportunities for growth. Regular interactions with our teams ensure their engagement, motivation, and recognition. We empower our team members to pursue their career goals with confidence and enthusiasm.
 Comprehensive Benefits: In addition to equitable compensation, we provide a comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes the overall well-being of our consultants. We genuinely care about their health and strive to create a positive work environment.
 Flexible Opportunities: At GlobalLogic, we prioritize work-life balance by offering flexible opportunities tailored to your lifestyle. Explore relocation and rotation options for diverse cultural and professional experiences in different countries with our company.
 About GlobalLogic
 GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.
